in_sanskrit.name: अशिरण्श
in_sanskrit.meaning: to gain or to acquire something in large quantity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: to obtain or to achieve something, to grasp or to understand something deeply

in_marathi.name: Ashiransh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wish, Desire, Aspiration
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashiransh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashiransh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ashi’ which means ‘wish, desire, aspiration’ and ‘ransh’ which means ‘to grasp, seize, or obtain’. This name is associated with the deity of fulfilled desires, Lord Kama.
